summary: Remote-controlled PTY backdoor with hardcoded WebSocket C2 and LLM credential harvesting
details: The package ships a Go binary for darwin-arm64 that opens a PTY on the installer's host (github.com/creack/pty) and connects to a hardcoded author-controlled WebSocket relay at wss://relay.sextant.top, giving a remote party interactive shell access on the installer's machine. The binary also embeds https://relay.sextant.top/install and https://claude.ai/install.sh together with sudo/curl/brew.zip tokens, providing an unpinned fetch-and-execute path from author-controlled infrastructure. It additionally embeds host-geolocation lookups against http://ip-api.com/json/ and handling for Anthropic/Gemini credential material (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, GEMINI_API_KEY, and a regex matching sk-ant- Anthropic API keys), co-located with the same relay endpoint. package.json's license reference points at github.com/ddos798/claude_control, aligning the shipped behavior with the publisher's self-description as remote-control tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
